mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Add an extra layer of security to your account
mfa.setupDescription: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it generates.
mfa.setupError: Could not start two-factor setup. Please try again.
mfa.verifyError: That code did not verify. Please try again.
mfa.recoveryDescription: Store these somewhere safe. Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app.
mfa.disableDescription: Your account will no longer require a verification code at sign-in.
mfa.disableVerifyLabel: Enter a verification code to confirm
